newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: TAC plunges to new low on Thai fears.
newsitem.headline: TAC plunges to new low on Thai fears.

text.p: Thai mobile phones operator Total Access Communications Plc (TAC) plunged to a new low of US$3.32 in afternoon trading on Wednesday.
At 0845 GMT, the shares were trading at US$3.78, down US$0.94 or about 20 percent from its previous close of US$4.72. Volume was a moderate 390,600 units.
Dealers said TAC's share price reflected the weak Thai stock market and gloomy economic outlook.
"The Thai market is really bad. And I think TAC is just reflecting what is happening there," a Singapore broker said.
Thai stocks tumbled to an eight-year low with the stock index are down 5.28 percent to 568.87 in late afternoon trade.

"There is also some concern about the recent government announcement that it will allow three new mobile operators to the Thai market. TAC has always been more expensive compared with its rivals so there is some derating of the stock going on here," said Gautam Kapoor, ING/Barings regional telecoms analyst.
